items.name: SoCal Dream

candidates.about: SoCal Dream, originally called the SoCal Dream Machine, was an all-age/senior drum corps that formed in Southern California in 2001 for performers no longer eligible for junior corps. The corps became independent under the Dream Association of California and competed in DCA/West Coast senior corps events through the early 2010s.

items.notes: Location evidence conflicts: DCX lists Los Angeles, CA; The Bash says Huntington Beach, CA; an old DCI yearbook listing used a Fountain Valley mailing address. Huntington Beach is the best profile-style candidate because it is explicitly described as the base of the performing unit, but this should be reviewed before applying. The website is historical and may be inactive.

items.name: Sonus Brass Theater

candidates.about: Sonus Brass Theater is an all-age brass, percussion and color guard ensemble based in Woodbridge, Virginia. A longtime DCI SoundSport participant, Sonus has earned gold ratings at the SoundSport International Music & Food Festival.

items.notes: The photo is from the official Sonus Brass Theater site and was verified as a direct downloadable JPEG. DCI and the official site agree on the SoundSport/all-age summary.

items.name: Southern Knights

candidates.about: Formed in 2015, Southern Knights is an all-age drum corps from Alabama. The corps' 2017 summer season marked its first season performing as part of Drum Corps International's All-Age division, and the organization emphasizes member development through teamwork, self-discipline, preparedness, accountability, critical thinking, and leadership.

items.notes: DCI's profile is strong for about/location/website. I did not find a verified direct logo or photo URL; the official site failed TLS from local fetches, and search snippets were not enough to support media assignment.

sources.title: Southern Knights - Drum Corps International
sources.notes: Redirects to southern-knights-2; confirms Pelham, AL, address, website, and official about text.

sources.title: 20+ ensembles locked in for exciting 2023 SoundSport season
sources.notes: Notes Southern Knights' move to Chattanooga from Birmingham and experience in SoundSport/DCA; this conflicts with the current DCI profile location, so Pelham remains the DCI-backed candidate.

items.name: Taipei Yuehfu

candidates.about: Taipei Yuehfu is a junior drum corps and marching arts group from Taipei, Taiwan. Founded in 1996, the corps represented Taiwan in DCI International Class competition and won the 2005 Division III Prelims before returning to DCI in 2013.

items.notes: DCI strongly supports the location/history. The official website is historical and may be inactive. Logo/photo candidates come from Taiwan Marching Band Association pages and were verified as direct downloadable media, but the page is broader than a single Taipei Yuehfu profile, so media should be reviewed visually before applying.
